title: Tether Blacklists USDT Wallets Linked to CoinDCX Outflows
ai_summary: Tether blacklisted USDT wallets linked to CoinDCX outflows, with AMLBot freezing about $2.2 million. The freeze follows CoinDCX's acknowledgment of losses from a failed process for securing deposits to retired addresses.

title: BNB Price Prediction: On CoinDCX's $745 Target With Bearish MACD and Two Moving Averages Left to Clear
ai_summary: BNB traded at $744.77 on Binance spot, nearly reaching CoinDCX's $745 target for October 31, 2026. The token sits below the SMA-20 at $745.53, with a bearish MACD and two overhead moving averages. A close above $750.37 would clear both, while a break below $743.21 would shift focus to support at $731.95.

title: BTC Price Prediction: MACD Flatlines at $81,882 as Open Interest Jumps 5.5% — Can Bulls Reclaim the Moving Average Stack?
ai_summary: Bitcoin slipped 0.78% to $81,882.22 on Binance spot markets, with its MACD histogram at zero and open interest rising 5.53% to 94,643.32 contracts. Price sits below the SMA 7 and EMA 12, while a CoinDCX base-case target of $84,000 requires a sustained close above $82,281–$82,500, which has not been met.
